messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error or the t-statistic? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error of the mean under null? Or they want to compute the p-value? The question: "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get population mean 98.6"? Might be they want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution (standard error) given sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and null mean 98.6. But standard error uses sample std dev / sqrt(n). That would be 1.4/sqrt(40)=1.4/6.3249=0.2215. But maybe they want to compute the t-statistic: (98.2-98.6)/(1.4/sqrt(40)) = -0.4/0.2215=-1.805. Then compute p-value. Let's use the tool to compute p-value. Provide sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. Use two_tailed default true.
